CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 3

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 1

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

   D. 17

   A. 400

   A. 8

   A. 4

   A. 170

15. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12

   D. 2

21. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73

22. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6

23. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)

   C. 4

24. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
3. c² = 81 + 144
4. c² = 225
5. c = 15
Final Answer: 15 cm
